def __init__(
        self,
        file: Path,
        local_config: dict[str, Any],
        package: ProjectPackage,
        locker: Locker,
        config: Config,
        disable_cache: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        from poetry.repositories.pool import Pool

        super().__init__(file, local_config, package)

        self._locker = locker
        self._config = config
        self._pool = Pool()
